map.基于血管生成标志物sFlt-1/PIGF比值预测与排除子痫前期(PROGNOSI: Predicting and ruling out preeclampsia from the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio (PROGNOSIS study)
map.血管生成比值 = sFlt-1 / PlGF；< 38 排除（1周 NPV 99: Angiogenic ratio = sFlt-1 / PlGF; below 38 rules it out (1-week NPV 99.3%), 38-85 (early-onset) or 110 (late-onset) is a grey zone, and at or above the threshold it is confirmed
map.子管疲痉预测以血管生成因子比值为核心，超过确诊阈值提示子管疲痉。: Prediction of preterm preeclampsia centres on the angiogenic factor ratio, and exceeding the diagnostic threshold indicates preterm preeclampsia.
map.用 sFlt-1/PlGF 等胎盘因子比值预测早发型子痫前期。: Use placental factor ratios such as sFlt-1/PlGF to predict early-onset preeclampsia.
map.中孕期风险分层决定是否阿司匹林预防。: Mid-pregnancy risk stratification decides whether prophylactic aspirin is used.
map.：sFlt-1/PlGF 比值 120（正常 <85、≥85 提示风险升高）：比: With an sFlt-1/PlGF ratio of 120 (normal below 85, 85 or above signals rising risk): the higher the ratio the greater the preeclampsia risk, so monitor blood pressure and urine protein closely and consider admission.
map.：比值 40（<85）：低风险，常规产检即可，但仍有晚发型可能，仍需监测血压。: A ratio of 40 (below 85) is low risk and routine checkups suffice, but the late-onset form is still possible, so keep monitoring blood pressure.
map.常用 sFlt-1/PlGF ≥85（孕 20–34+6 周）提示短期内子痫前期: An sFlt-1/PlGF ratio of 85 or above (at 20-34+6 weeks) signals elevated near-term preeclampsia risk, while 655 or above leans toward the early-onset type; combine it with blood pressure and urine protein.
map.高风险者可从孕 16 周起小剂量阿司匹林预防，降低早发型子痫前期发生率；已发病则: High-risk patients may start low-dose aspirin from 16 weeks to prevent preeclampsia and reduce early-onset cases; once it has developed, focus on blood pressure control and timely delivery.
